title: Architecture Before the Formula: Individuating Neural Architecture Beyond the Composite Map
abstract: arXiv:2601.11618v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural architecture is often identified by module syntax, computation graphs, or the composite functions they realize. These descriptions answer different identity questions. We study the represented process available at a receiver: an actual factorization $B_j=G_jQ_j$ in which $Q_j(x)$ is the intermediate state supplied for further computation. Forgetting the presentation and retaining only $\ker Q_j$ yields the predecessor distinctions preserved at that cut. For a fixed branch, this extensional shadow exactly classifies unmarked surjective factorizations up to unique carrier re-presentation, but it does not determine marked receiver organization or the accessibility of retained information to restricted continuations. Under composition the relevant interface is $Q_{j,\theta}A$, so downstream architectural distinctions depend on the states produced upstream. An exact two-token construction shows that local and attention schema

translated_title: 公式之前的架构：超越复合映射的神经架构个体化
translated_abstract: 神经架构通常通过模块语法、计算图或它们实现的复合函数来识别。这些描述回答了不同的身份问题。我们研究了接收器处可用的表示过程：一个实际的分解$B_j=G_jQ_j$，其中$Q_j(x)$是为进一步计算提供的中间状态。忽略表示形式而仅保留$\ker Q_j$，可以得到在该截断处保留的前驱区分。对于固定分支，这种外延影子精确地将未标记的满射分解分类到唯一载体重新表示，但它不决定标记的接收器组织或受限延续对保留信息的可访问性。在组合下，相关接口是$Q_{j,\theta}A$，因此下游架构区分取决于上游产生的状态。一个精确的双令牌构造表明，局部和注意力模式存在差异。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于中间状态核的架构个体化方法，揭示了传统复合映射无法捕捉的架构身份差异，并通过双令牌构造展示了局部与注意力机制的本质区别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an architecture individuation method based on intermediate state kernels, revealing identity distinctions beyond composite maps, and demonstrates essential differences between local and attention mechanisms via a two-token construction.
